Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlchemistsBo.description: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlchemistsBo.name: Alchemist's Boon

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCry.description: Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCry.name: Ancestral Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCry.tagString: Attack, Buff, AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Nova, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralSpr.description: Each of your Totems will summon an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem that summoned the Minion dies then the Ancestral Spirit will too.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralSpr.name: Ancestral Spirits

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.description: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that uses socketed Mace Skills. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.tagString: Totem, AoE, Melee, Duration, Conditional, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemApocalypse.description: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemApocalypse.name: Apocalypse
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemApocalypse.tagString: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional, Storm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.name: Arc

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchmage.description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchmage.name: Archmage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.description: Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.name: Armour Breaker

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourPierci.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourPierci.name: Armour Piercing Rounds

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that rains down a salvo of Pinning, Maiming bolts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.name: Artillery Ballista

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyAl.description: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyAl.name: Align Fate

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyBl.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyBl.name: Bleeding Concoction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyCo.description: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyCo.name: Kelari's Malediction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEl.description: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEl.name: Elemental Expression
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEl.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaining

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEl.description: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEl.name: Elemental Storm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEl.tagString: AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Orb

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEn.description: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEn.name: Encase in Jade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEx.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyEx.name: Explosive Concoction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyFu.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyFu.name: Fulminating Concoction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyLi.description: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyLi.name: Life Remnants

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyMe.description: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyMe.name: Meditate

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyMo.description: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyMo.name: Moment of Vulnerability

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyPo.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyPo.name: Acidic Concoction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySh.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Cold Attack damage in an area and inflicting Exposure.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySh.name: Shattering Concoction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.description: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.name: Ruzhan, the Blazing Sword

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.description: Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.name: Summon Infernal Hound

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.description: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.name: Kelari, the Tainted Sands

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.description: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.name: Navira, the Last Mirage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyTr.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyTr.name: Elemental Surge

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyUn.description: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyUn.name: Unbound Avatar

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAttrition.description: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAttrition.name: Attrition

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.name: Ball Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarkskin.description: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarkskin.name: Barkskin

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.description: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Barrageable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.name: Barrage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.description: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.name: Barrier Invocation

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearFuryOfTh.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearFuryOfTh.name: Fury of the Mountain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearFuryOfTh.tagString: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Duration, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.name: Maul

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.name: Rampage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.tagString: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Channelling, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBerserk.description: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBerserk.name: Berserk

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlackPowderB.description: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlackPowderB.name: Black Powder Blitz
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlackPowderB.tagString: Persistent, AoE, Physical, Fire, Detonator, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.description: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.name: Blasphemy

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlinkReserva.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlinkReserva.name: Blink

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodBoil.description: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodBoil.name: Blood Boil

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.description: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.name: Blood Hunt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodhoundsM.description: Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. If they suffer enough Blood Loss while Marked, the Mark will Activate, Consuming itself and releasing an explosion of blood when they are killed or Heavy Stunned. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodhoundsM.name: Bloodhound's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodhoundsM.tagString: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneBlast.description: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneBlast.name: Bone Blast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneCage.description: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneCage.name: Bone Cage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.description: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.name: Bone Offering

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.description: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.name: Boneshatter

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBonestorm.description: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBonestorm.name: Bonestorm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.description: While active, a portion of the Physical Attack damage you deal is stored. Casting a Spell uses the stored damage to create a patch of Thorny Ground that deals Spell damage to moving enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.name: Briarpatch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.tagString: Spell, Persistent, AoE, Sustained, Physical, Duration, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.name: Curse on Block

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastFireSpel.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastFireSpel.name: Fire Spell on Hit

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastLightnin.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Lightning spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastLightnin.name: Thundergod's Wrath

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.name: Cast on Block

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.name: Cast on Charm Use

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.name: Cast on Critical

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.name: Cast on Dodge

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.tagString: Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.name: Cast on Melee Kill

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.description: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.name: Cast on Melee Stun

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMinion.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMinion.name: Cast on Minion Death

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.description: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.name: Chaos Bolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargeRegula.description: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargeRegula.name: Charge Regulation

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.description: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.name: Charged Staff
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.tagString: Attack, Buff, AoE, Lightning, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClusterGrena.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClusterGrena.name: Cluster Grenade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.description: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.name: Combat Frenzy

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.name: Comet

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductivity.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Lightning Resistance.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductivity.name: Conductivity

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.description:
Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it and all other Chaos damage over time Debuffs spread to nearby enemies and refresh their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to
spread Contagion on hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.name: Contagion

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConvalescenc.description: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConvalescenc.name: Convalescence

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpseCloud.description: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpseCloud.name: Decompose

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.name: Crackling Palm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrossbowRequ.description: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrossbowRequ.name: Requiem

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCullTheWeak.description: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCullTheWeak.name: Cull The Weak

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkEffigy.description: Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkEffigy.name: Dark Effigy

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefianceBann.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefianceBann.name: Defiance Banner
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefianceBann.tagString: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDemonForm.description: Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDemonForm.name: Demon Form

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.name: Despair

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.description: Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.name: Detonate Dead

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateMini.description: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateMini.name: Detonate Minion

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonatingAr.description: Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonatingAr.name: Detonating Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonatingAr.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Channelling, Detonator, Staged, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.description: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.name: Discipline

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.description: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.name: Disengage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDreadBanner.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDreadBanner.name: Dread Banner
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDreadBanner.tagString: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.name: Earthquake

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.description: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.name: Earthshatter

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElectrocutin.description: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElectrocutin.name: Electrocuting Arrow

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalCon.description: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalCon.name: Elemental Conflux

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalInv.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalInv.name: Elemental Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalInv.tagString: Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Invocation, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalSun.description: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalSun.name: Elemental Sundering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalSun.tagString: AoE, Melee, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Nova, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalWea.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalWea.name: Elemental Weakness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalWea.tagString: AoE, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Curse

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmberFusilla.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmberFusilla.name: Ember Fusillade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmergencyRel.description: Instantly reload all your Crossbow Ammunition clips and Empower each clip's Ammunition to deal more damage for a duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmergencyRel.name: Emergency Reload

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEntangle.description: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEntangle.name: Entangle

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.name: Escape Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.name: Essence Drain

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalRage.description: While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalRage.name: Eternal Rage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplodingPoi.description: A Poisonous Toad leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing damage in an area and inflicting Poison.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplodingPoi.name: Bursting Fen Toad

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGre.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGre.name: Explosive Grenade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveSho.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveSho.name: Explosive Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveSpe.description: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveSpe.name: Explosive Spear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveSpe.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Duration, Detonator, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.description: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.description: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.name: Falling Thunder

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.description: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.name: Fangs of Frost

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.description: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.name: Feast of Flesh

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeralInvocat.description: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeralInvocat.name: Feral Invocation

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.name: Ferocious Roar

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFireball.description: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFireball.name: Fireball

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.name: Firebolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.name: Firestorm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.description: Create a wall of Fire in front of the character, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.name: Flame Wall

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.description: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channelled for.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.name: Flameblast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlammability.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Fire Resistance.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlammability.name: Flammability

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlashGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlashGrenade.name: Flash Grenade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.description: Teleport to a enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.name: Flicker Strike

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForgeHammer.description: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForgeHammer.name: Forge Hammer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForgeHammer.tagString: AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Fire, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFortifyingCr.description: Perform a Warcry that grants Guard and Triggers Shield Wave when subsequent Shield Attacks deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFortifyingCr.name: Fortifying Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFortifyingCr.tagString: Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Nova

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentatio.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentatio.name: Fragmentation Rounds

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingMark.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingMark.name: Freezing Mark

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingSalv.description: Passively coalesces icy missiles from the air over time. Using the skill fires a missile, firing an additional missile for each that has been accumulated. Fires an additional missile, up to its current missile count, targeting each Ice Fragment in its Area of effect, causing the Fragments to Detonate immediately.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingSalv.name: Freezing Salvo

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingShar.description: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingShar.name: Freezing Shards

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBolt.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBolt.name: Frostbolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.description: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.name: Frost Bomb

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostDarts.description: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostDarts.name: Frost Darts

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.description: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.name: Frost Wall

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrozenLocus.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrozenLocus.name: Frozen Locus

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFulmination.description: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFulmination.name: Fulmination

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.name: Furious Slam

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.description: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.name: Future-Past

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.description: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.name: Galvanic Field
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.tagString: Spell, AoE, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Orb

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicShar.description: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. These fragments can Merge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicShar.name: Galvanic Shards

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGasArrow.description: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGasArrow.name: Gas Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGasArrow.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Chaos, Duration, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGatheringSto.description: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing dashes towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through and leaves a trail of Shocked Ground in your wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGatheringSto.name: Gathering Storm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGatheringSto.tagString: AoE, Melee, Lightning, Duration, Channelling, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGeminiSurge.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGeminiSurge.name: Gemini Surge

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.description: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.name: Ghost Dance

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialBolt.description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialBolt.name: Glacial Bolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.name: Glacial Cascade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.description: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.name: Glacial Lance

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimFeast.description: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimFeast.name: Grim Feast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHailstormRou.description: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHailstormRou.name: Hailstorm Rounds

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHammerOfTheG.description: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHammerOfTheG.name: Hammer of the Gods

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHandOfChayul.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHandOfChayul.name: Hand of Chayula

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeartOfIce.description: Chills all enemies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeartOfIce.name: Heart of Ice

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.name: Herald of Ash

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfBloo.description: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies based off the life of the exploded enemy, destroying their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic. The explosion also has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfBloo.name: Herald of Blood
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfBloo.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.name: Herald of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Cold, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfPlag.description: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfPlag.name: Herald of Plague

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which deals Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.name: Herald of Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Lightning, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.description: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.name: Hexblast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHighVelocity.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHighVelocity.name: High Velocity Rounds

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.name: His Foul Emergence

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.name: His Winnowing Flame

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.description: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.name: Cackling Companions

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHypothermia.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Cold Resistance.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHypothermia.name: Hypothermia

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.name: Ice Nova

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceShards.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceShards.name: Ice Shards
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceShards.tagString: AoE, Ammunition, Projectile, Sustained, Cold, Hazard

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceShot.description: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceShot.name: Ice Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.name: Ice Strike

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceTippedArr.description: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Barrageable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and create Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceTippedArr.name: Ice-Tipped Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceTippedArr.tagString: Attack, Buff, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcestorm.description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcestorm.name: Icestorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcestorm.tagString: AoE, Sustained, Cold, Duration, Payoff, Storm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.name: Impurity

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncendiarySh.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncendiarySh.name: Incendiary Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.name: Incinerate

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInevitableAg.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Curse debuff. When the debuff's duration expires, they take that tracked damage again, all at once.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInevitableAg.name: Inevitable Agony

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernallCry.description: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernallCry.name: Infernal Cry

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIntoTheBreac.description: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIntoTheBreac.name: Into the Breach

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIronWard.description: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIronWard.name: Iron Ward

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.name: Killing Palm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.name: Lightning Arrow

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.name: Lightning Bolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.description: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.name: Lightning Conduit

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningRod.description: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningRod.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.description: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.name: Lightning Spear

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.name: Lightning Warp

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.name: Lingering Illusion

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLivingBombPl.description: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLivingBombPl.name: Living Bomb

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLunarAssault.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLunarAssault.name: Lunar Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLunarAssault.tagString: Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Strike, Cold

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.description: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to create an explosion, granting you an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.name: Magma Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagneticSalv.description: Aim skyward and fires energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagneticSalv.name: Magnetic Salvo

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMalice.description: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMalice.name: Malice

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaDrain.description: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaDrain.name: Mana Drain

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaRemnants.description: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaRemnants.name: Mana Remnants

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.description: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.name: Mana Tempest

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManifestWeap.description: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManifestWeap.name: Manifest Weapon

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMantraOfDest.description:
Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants
Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMantraOfDest.name: Mantra of Destruction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaDeadeyeM.description: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaDeadeyeM.name: Called Shots

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaSpellTot.description: Consume any combination of 3 Power and/or Endurance Charges to raise a Totem that uses socketed Spells. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaSpellTot.name: Spell Totem

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirageArcher.description: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirageArcher.name: Mirage Archer

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.name: Mirror of Refraction

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenBlast.description: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenBlast.name: Molten Blast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.description: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.name: Molten Crash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.tagString: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMortarCannon.description: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMortarCannon.name: Mortar Cannon

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilBarrage.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilBarrage.name: Oil Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilBarrage.tagString: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilGrenade.name: Oil Grenade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.description: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.name: Orb of Storms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.tagString: AoE, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Orb, Remnant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverwhelming.description: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverwhelming.name: Overwhelming Presence

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.description: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.name: Pain Offering

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemParry.description: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Strike or Projectile that would Hit you, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemParry.name: Parry

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerfectStrik.description: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerfectStrik.name: Perfect Strike

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPermafrostBo.description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPermafrostBo.name: Permafrost Bolts

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPhantasmalAr.description: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPhantasmalAr.name: Phantasmal Arrow

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinnacleOfPo.description: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinnacleOfPo.name: Pinnacle of Power
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinnacleOfPo.tagString: Buff, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.description: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.name: Plague Bearer

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlasmaBlast.description: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlasmaBlast.name: Plasma Blast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlayerDefaul.description: Fire an arrow with your Bow.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlayerDefaul.name: Bow Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlayerDefaul.description: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlayerDefaul.name: Crossbow Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlayerDefaul.description: Hurl your Spear with force. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to cause the Spear to explode at the end of its flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlayerDefaul.name: Spear Throw

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonBurstA.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonBurstA.name: Poisonburst Arrow

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.name: Power Siphon

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrimalStrike.description: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrimalStrike.name: Primal Strikes

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProfaneRitua.description: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProfaneRitua.name: Profane Ritual

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.name: Purity of Fire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.name: Purity of Ice

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.name: Purity of Lightning

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRagingSpirit.description: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRagingSpirit.name: Raging Spirits

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.description: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes a Frenzy Charge to fire more arrows.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.name: Rain of Arrows

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.description: Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRake.description: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRake.name: Rake

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.description: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.name: Rapid Assault

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidShot.description: Load your Crossbow with a large clip of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire them, and reaching maximum Heat will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidShot.name: Rapid Shot

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRavenousSwar.description: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable Minions that Attack and Poison enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRavenousSwar.name: Ravenous Swarm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.description: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness. Cannot be Triggered.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.name: Reap

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReapersInvoc.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReapersInvoc.name: Reaper's Invocation

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemResonatingSh.description: Repeatedly hammer your Shield with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose Armour for a duration. While Channelling Resonating Shield, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemResonatingSh.name: Resonating Shield

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMount.description: Harnesses a Companion Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a Bow or Spear. While mounted you can use Bow, thrown Spear, and Mark Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being Hit will cause Heavy Stun buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMount.name: Rhoa Mount

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRitualSacrif.description: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRitualSacrif.name: Ritual Sacrifice

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill Chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on Molten Fissures or Volcanos will activate them as though they were Slammed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.tagString: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Projectile, Fire, Detonator

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.description: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.name: Rolling Slam

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSacrifice.description: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSacrifice.name: Sacrifice

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScatteringCa.description: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScatteringCa.name: His Scattering Calamity

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScavengedPla.description: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. Fully Breaking an enemy's Armour grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's rarity, and you gain Armour and Thorns per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScavengedPla.name: Scavenged Plating

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.description: Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.name: Seismic Cry

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShardScaveng.description: While active, Consuming Freeze, Shock, Ignite, or Fully Broken Armour on an enemy reloads your Crossbow, restores one cooldown use for your Grenades and grants a Buff causing Crossbow Attacks to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShardScaveng.name: Shard Scavenger
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShardScaveng.tagString: Persistent, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.name: Shattering Palm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.description: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your Presence to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and Leech Life from enemies caught in the blast.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.name: Shattering Spite

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldBlock.description: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldBlock.name: Raise Shield

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.description: Channel to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldWall.description: Ram your Shield into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your Slams, Warcries, and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldWall.name: Shield Wall

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that discharges an Electrocuting Lightning blast when its fuse expires, causing all Lightning Hits against enemies to contribute to Electrocution buildup for a duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockGrenade.name: Voltaic Grenade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockburstRo.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockburstRo.name: Shockburst Rounds
