Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockchainAr.description: Fire a Lightning-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by Lightning Ailments. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and Chain towards nearby targets, with those Chaining Hits also releasing a shockwave. After the final Chain, the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. Consumes Shock from enemies it Hits, but not Electrocution.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockchainAr.name: Shockchain Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockchainAr.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Lightning, Chaining, Payoff, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.description: Raise a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it. The Totem cannot create Jagged Ground. This Skill can be used while Shapeshifted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.name: Shockwave Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.tagString: Totem, AoE, Melee, Slam, Duration, Nova

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeBallist.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeBallist.name: Siege Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeBallist.tagString: Totem, AoE, Projectile, Fire, Duration, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeCascade.description: Load your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeCascade.name: Siege Cascade

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.name: Sigil of Power

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphonElemen.description: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphonElemen.name: Siphon Elements

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphoningStr.description: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphoningStr.name: Siphoning Strike

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.description: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.name: Skeletal Arsonist

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.description: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.name: Skeletal Brute

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.name: Skeletal Cleric

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.name: Skeletal Frost Mage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.description: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.name: Skeletal Reaver

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.name: Skeletal Sniper

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.name: Skeletal Storm Mage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.name: Skeletal Warrior

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnap.description: Consume the elemental energy from a Frozen, Shocked or Ignited enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an Infusion Remnant. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same Ailment, but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnap.name: Snap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnap.tagString: AoE, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Payoff, Remnant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipe.description: Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with Perfect Timing causes the arrow to explode on impact and Consume Freeze on directly Hitting. Consuming Freeze enhances the explosion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipe.name: Snipe
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipe.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Cold, Channelling, Payoff, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.description: Mark a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives Activates the Mark, Consuming it to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.name: Sniper's Mark

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSolarOrb.description: Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSolarOrb.name: Solar Orb

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSorceryWard.description: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSorceryWard.name: Sorcery Ward

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulOffering.description: Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions.  The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulOffering.name: Soul Offering

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.description: Fire a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.name: Soulrend

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.name: Spark

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearOfSolar.description: Build Glory by inflicting Freeze, Shock or Ignite on enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your Spear in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding Ignited Ground. Modifiers to number of Projectiles fired do not apply to this skill.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearOfSolar.name: Spear of Solaris

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.description: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and Maiming them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.name: Spearfield

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellslinger.description: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellslinger.name: Spellslinger

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.description: Load your Bow with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes Frenzy Charges to cause the arrows to deal more damage and Chain to other targets. Each target can only be Hit once.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.name: Spiral Volley

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.description: Create an area of Consecrated Ground around you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.name: Consecrate

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, instantly Heavily Stunning enemies which are Primed for Stun and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Primed targets in range if your first target was Stunned. Heavy Stunning an enemy with this Skill grants you a Buff that causes your Quarterstaff Attacks to also fire Projectiles for a short duration. Heavy Stunning additional enemies adds to the Buff's duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.name: Staggering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.tagString: Buff, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Physical, Duration, Wind

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStampede.description: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of Jagged Ground with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping Slam damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of Jagged Ground to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of Attack speed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStampede.name: Stampede

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormLance.description: Throw an electrified Spear that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with Lightning bolts. If the Spear is Detonated by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create Shocked Ground on Detonation.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormLance.name: Storm Lance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormLance.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Barrageable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormWave.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff, projecting a bolt of Lightning through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormWave.name: Storm Wave

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormblastBo.description: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a Detonator Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormblastBo.name: Stormblast Bolts

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormcallerA.description: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Shock. Shocking any enemy with the Bolt also applies Shock to all enemies near the impact.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormcallerA.name: Stormcaller Arrow

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.description: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.name: Companion: {0}

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.name: Spectre: {0}

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.description: Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.name: Sunder

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.name: Supercharged Slam

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupportingFi.description: Recruit artillery Minions that takes up positions behind you. They will lay in wait for your Command then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupportingFi.name: Supporting Fire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTameBeast.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTameBeast.name: Tame Beast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemperWeapon.description: Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemperWeapon.name: Temper Weapon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemperWeapon.tagString: Buff, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestBell.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestBell.name: Tempest Bell

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.description: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.name: Tempest Flurry

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.name: Temporal Chains

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalRift.description: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalRift.name: Temporal Rift

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrashingVin.description: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrashingVin.name: Thrashing Vines

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderousLe.description: Leap into the air and plunge your Spear into the ground at the target location, emitting a Lightning-charged shockwave.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderousLe.name: Thunderous Leap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderousLe.tagString: AoE, Melee, Slam, Lightning, Detonator, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.description: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTimeFreeze.description: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTimeFreeze.name: Time Freeze

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTimeOfNeed.description: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTimeOfNeed.name: Time of Need

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTimeSnap.description: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTimeSnap.name: Time Snap

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.description: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.name: Tornado

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornadoShot.description: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornadoShot.name: Tornado Shot
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornadoShot.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Physical, Duration, Barrageable, Wind

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicDomain.description: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your Projectile Attacks attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be Poisoned. Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicDomain.name: Toxic Domain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicDomain.tagString: Attack, AoE, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrenade.name: Gas Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrenade.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Grenade, Fire, Chaos, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrowth.description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrowth.name: Toxic Growth

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.description: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.name: Trail of Caltrops
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.tagString: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Hazard

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrinity.description: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Resonance based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Resonance of any type you have.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrinity.name: Trinity

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTwister.description: Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTwister.name: Twister

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnearth.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnearth.name: Unearth

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueBreach.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueBreach.name: Lightning Bolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnleash.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Spell you cast to repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnleash.name: Unleash

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.description: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.name: Valako's Charge

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVaultingImpa.description: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVaultingImpa.name: Vaulting Impact
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVaultingImpa.tagString: AoE, Melee, Slam, Physical, Duration, Travel, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.name: His Vile Intrusion

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVineArrow.description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVineArrow.name: Vine Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVineArrow.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Chaos, Duration, Barrageable, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoidIllusion.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoidIllusion.name: Void Illusion

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.description: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.name: Volatile Dead

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.description: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.name: Volcanic Fissure
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.tagString: AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Fire, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.description: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.name: Volcano
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.tagString: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicMark.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicMark.name: Voltaic Mark

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVulnerabilit.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay. making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVulnerabilit.name: Vulnerability

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.description: Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.name: Walking Calamity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.tagString: Shapeshift, Buff, Bear, AoE, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarBanner.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarBanner.name: War Banner
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarBanner.tagString: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Aura, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWaveOfFrost.description: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWaveOfFrost.name: Wave of Frost

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingAssa.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingAssa.name: Whirling Assault

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingSlas.description: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingSlas.name: Whirling Slash

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlwindLan.description: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlwindLan.name: Whirlwind Lance

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindBlast.description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindBlast.name: Wind Blast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindDancer.description: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindDancer.name: Wind Dancer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindDancer.tagString: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Staged

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindSerpents.description: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindSerpents.name: Wind Serpent's Fury

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWingBlast.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. Enemies Primed for Heavy Stun will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWingBlast.name: Wing Blast

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWither.description: Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWither.name: Wither

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringPre.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringPre.name: Withering Presence

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfArcticHo.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and Freezes Primed enemies. If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfArcticHo.name: Arctic Howl
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfArcticHo.tagString: Shapeshift, Buff, Werewolf, AoE, Cold, Duration, Nova

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfCrossSla.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfCrossSla.name: Cross Slash

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfLunarBle.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfLunarBle.name: Lunar Blessing
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfLunarBle.tagString: Attack, Shapeshift, Buff, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPack.description: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPack.name: Wolf Pack

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.name: Pounce
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.tagString: Minion, Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Mark, Duration, Travel, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfShred.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfShred.name: Shred
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfShred.tagString: Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernDevour.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernDevour.name: Devour

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernFlameB.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to Empower the Skill, Gaining extra Lightning damage and spending Rage more slowly.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernFlameB.name: Flame Breath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernFlameB.tagString: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Channelling, Detonator

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernRend.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernRend.name: Rend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernRend.tagString: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Melee, Strike, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipSupport.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself or that you Trigger. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuptureSuppo.description: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuptureSuppo.name: Rupture

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRustedSpikes.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuthlessSupp.description: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSacrificialL.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing your skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSelflessRemn.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockConduct.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatilitySu.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatilitySu.name: Volatility

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicErup.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicErup.name: Volcanic Eruption
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicErup.tagString: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Fire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltSupport.description: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltSupport.name: Volt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWallFortress.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWallFortress.name: Fortress I

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWallFortress.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWallFortress.name: Fortress II

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarmBloodedS.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarmBloodedS.name: Warm Blooded

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildfireSupp.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildfireSupp.name: Wildfire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.name: Wildshards I

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.name: Sione's Temper

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.name: Wildshards II

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindowOfOppo.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindowOfOppo.name: Window of Opportunity I

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindowOfOppo.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindowOfOppo.name: Window of Opportunity II

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringTou.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringTou.name: Withering Touch

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXibaquasRend.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXibaquasRend.name: Xibaqua's Rending

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXophsPyreSup.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXophsPyreSup.name: Xoph's Pyre

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRefra.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location. Supported Spells echo thrice, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay, but Supported Skills are given a short Cooldown. Cannot support Channelling skills, Remote skills, skills which already have a Cooldown, or skills which are Triggered.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRefra.name: Zarokh's Refrain

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRevol.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, making their effect reoccur up to five times when cast, but giving them a moderate Cooldown. Cannot support Channelling Skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRevol.name: Zarokh's Revolt

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.name: Zenith I

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.name: Zenith II

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZerphisLegac.description:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZerphisLegac.name: Zerphi's Infamy
